description:
🚀 MISSION ECHO is a creative and ambitious team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We’re bringing forgotten space missions back to life through science, technology, and storytelling. We’re looking for passionate, curious, and creative teammates ready to share ideas, explore space, and create something extraordinary together!

Every Mission Leaves a Legacy! 🌌
